nav.back_to_super_admin: Back to the super admin panel

index.title: Platform team
index.body: This panel is for the people who run the whole platform. Choose a page from the menu.
index.not_found_title: That page is not in this panel
index.not_found_body: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have moved. Choose a page from the menu.

home.title: Platform health
home.intro: A quick check that everything the platform runs on is working. Anything that could not be checked says so.
home.load_error_title: We couldn't check the platform just now
home.unknown_note: This could not be checked, so its state is not known.

overall.unknown: Some checks could not be read

value.browser_same: This browser is on the same version.
value.browser_other: This browser is on a different version. Reload the page.

failed_jobs.title: Failed background jobs
failed_jobs.intro: Work the platform tried to do in the background and could not finish, such as an email it could not send. Run one again, or discard it if it is no longer needed.
failed_jobs.load_error_title: We couldn't load the failed jobs just now
failed_jobs.empty_text: No background job has failed, or every one has been dealt with.
failed_jobs.retried: The job is back in the queue.
failed_jobs.action_failed: That didn't work. Nothing was changed.
failed_jobs.discard_message: The work it stood for will not be done, and this cannot be undone.

phone_app.title: Phone app
phone_app.intro: Who has the phone app, in every community on the platform. Members are named; their email addresses are not shown.
phone_app.not_downloads: These are members signed in on the app, not downloads from the app stores.
phone_app.load_error_title: We couldn't load the phone app figures just now
